question: Theyyam dance, performed to appease and make peace with the Gods who ensure good harvest and prosperity, is popular in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Theyyam** is a traditional dance form that is highly popular in the state of Kerala.
 
• It is performed to appease and make peace with the Gods who are believed to ensure good harvest and prosperity.
 
• Theyyam is also known as **Kaliyattam** and is characterized by elaborate costumes, vibrant makeup, and intense dance movements.
 
• This dance form is rooted in the **ritualistic traditions** of Kerala and is performed in temples and sacred groves.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Theyyam**

 
 
• Theyyam is a popular Hindu ritual form of worship in Kerala, India.
 
• It encompasses dance, mime, and music, and enshrines the rudiments of ancient tribal cultures, which attached great importance to the worship of heroes and the spirits of ancestors.
 
• The performers of Theyyam belong to the lower caste community, and through the performance, they are elevated to a divine status.
 
• Theyyam is performed from December to April, and over 400 different forms of Theyyam exist today.
 
 
 
• **Costumes and Makeup**
 
 
• The costumes and makeup of Theyyam are elaborate and vibrant, with significant use of face paints, masks, and headgear.
 
• The makeup is often done by the performers themselves, and it can take several hours to complete.
 
• The costumes include coconut leaves, cloth, and other natural materials, and they play a crucial role in defining the character being portrayed.
 
 
 
• **Ritualistic Significance**
 
 
• Theyyam is deeply intertwined with the spiritual and religious life of the people in Kerala.
 
• The performance is believed to bring blessings, protection, and prosperity to the community.
 
• It is also a means of storytelling, where myths and legends are narrated through the dance and music.
 
 
 
• **Modern Influence**
 
 
• Theyyam has gained popularity beyond Kerala and is now performed at cultural festivals and events across India and the world.
 
• Despite its traditional roots, Theyyam has adapted to contemporary times while retaining its core essence.
